fallback_policy.note: healthcheck records local manifest state only; it never executes cloud fallback

healthcheck_prompt:
Return exactly one JSON object and no prose. The JSON object must contain these exact keys and values:
{
  "LOCAL_ONLY": true,
  "backend": "vllm",
  "cloud_fallback_allowed": false,
  "git_sha": "3bb6821e687db39d384abd7f6fcb00cee6f7c6c1",
  "gpu_memory_utilization": 0.82,
  "gpu_name": "unknown",
  "max_model_len": 24576,
  "max_num_seqs": 1,
  "model_name": "Qwen/Qwen3-14B-AWQ",
  "prompt_version": "qwen-health-json-v1",
  "quantization": "AWQ",
  "schema_version": "local-qwen-health/v1",
  "vram_gb": 24.0
}
